AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Authorized FEVIQO administrator record synced with Firestore for verification and membership management.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the administrator.

isActive.description: Whether the administrator account is currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was last updated.

MemberAccount.title: MemberAccount
MemberAccount.description: FEVIQO customer account profile with isolated PII accessible only to the owning member or an active administrator.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member or admin_assigned marker when created by admin.

passwordHash.description: Salted PBKDF2 hash when registered via email and password.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member document was written.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member document was last updated.

MembershipOrder.title: MembershipOrder
MembershipOrder.description: Customer Bank QR checkout request and payment proof submission in the admin verification queue.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer who owns the order.

selectedDramaIds.description: Selected eligible drama IDs (1 to 10 entries).

proofDataUrl.description: Compressed data URL of the payment screenshot under 800KB so it persists across restarts.

CustomerMembership.title: CustomerMembership
CustomerMembership.description: Active, expired, or cancelled customer membership record activated by admin approval or direct assignment.

MembershipHistoryItem.title: MembershipHistoryItem
MembershipHistoryItem.description: Immutable activity log entry for a customer membership lifecycle event.

MembershipSettings.title: MembershipSettings
MembershipSettings.description: Admin-managed Bank QR and Binance USD QR images, USD pricing, WhatsApp support digits, and verification copy.

EmailNotificationItem.title: EmailNotificationItem
EmailNotificationItem.description: Admin record of outbound payment and membership verification email notifications.

MemberNotification.title: MemberNotification
MemberNotification.description: In-account customer notification for renewal reminders, expiry notices, payment verification outcomes, and extensions.

SchedulerRun.title: SchedulerRun
SchedulerRun.description: Audit record of automated membership expiry and renewal reminder scheduler executions.

ReferralRecord.title: ReferralRecord
ReferralRecord.description: Attributed signup and verified conversion reward record between referrer and referred member.

ReferralCreditEntry.title: ReferralCreditEntry
ReferralCreditEntry.description: Immutable ledger entry for member referral credits earned, spent, or refunded.

ReferralCampaign.title: ReferralCampaign
ReferralCampaign.description: Partner / influencer referral tracking campaign independent of promo codes.

ReferralVisit.title: ReferralVisit
ReferralVisit.description: Individual click/visit logged from a partner referral link.

ReferralUniqueVisitor.title: ReferralUniqueVisitor
ReferralUniqueVisitor.description: Deduplicated unique visitor record per referral campaign.

UserCampaignAttribution.title: UserCampaignAttribution
UserCampaignAttribution.description: Persistent user account attribution to a referral campaign.

OrderCampaignAttribution.title: OrderCampaignAttribution
OrderCampaignAttribution.description: Checkout order attribution linking membership purchases to a referral campaign.

CampaignCommission.title: CampaignCommission
CampaignCommission.description: Snapshotted partner commission record generated only after verified membership payment.

CommissionPayment.title: CommissionPayment
CommissionPayment.description: Immutable partner commission payout batch history.

MonthlyCommissionReport.title: MonthlyCommissionReport
MonthlyCommissionReport.description: Permanent monthly referral commission report snapshot keyed by YYYY-MM.

BlockedUser.title: BlockedUser
BlockedUser.description: Permanently blocked email address and associated phone number(s) denied access across FEVIQO until unblocked by an administrator.

WhatsAppAutomationSettings.title: WhatsAppAutomationSettings
WhatsAppAutomationSettings.description: Backend-managed WhatsApp Cloud API automation toggles, delays, Meta template approval registry, and AI support configuration.

WhatsAppPreference.title: WhatsAppPreference
WhatsAppPreference.description: Explicit per-user WhatsApp notification consent categories and STOP opt-out status.

WhatsAppMessageLog.title: WhatsAppMessageLog
WhatsAppMessageLog.description: Outbound and inbound WhatsApp Cloud API message delivery, read, and failure audit log.

AutomationScheduledJob.title: AutomationScheduledJob
AutomationScheduledJob.description: Scheduled delayed WhatsApp reminders (30-min incomplete signup, checkout abandonment, expiry reminders, lead follow-ups).

EpisodeBroadcastRecord.title: EpisodeBroadcastRecord
EpisodeBroadcastRecord.description: Audit log of published Urdu episode WhatsApp alerts sent to entitled active subscribers.

VideoEditingLead.title: VideoEditingLead
VideoEditingLead.description: FEVIQO Creative video editing enquiry and CRM pipeline record.

WhatsAppConversationThread.title: WhatsAppConversationThread
WhatsAppConversationThread.description: Unified customer WhatsApp conversation history with AI classification and human takeover state.

WhatsAppWebhookEvent.title: WhatsAppWebhookEvent
WhatsAppWebhookEvent.description: Sanitized audit record of incoming Meta WhatsApp Cloud API GET verification challenges and POST webhook deliveries/failures.

WhatsAppWebhookDedupe.title: WhatsAppWebhookDedupe
WhatsAppWebhookDedupe.description: Idempotent deduplication key stored in Firestore to prevent duplicate webhook replay processing across Render restarts.

WhatsAppNotification.title: WhatsAppNotification
WhatsAppNotification.description: Server-generated one-click WhatsApp customer notification queue item with strict phone validation, status lifecycle (pending, opened, confirmed_sent, failed, cancelled), and admin audit log.

SupporterLeaderboardEntry.title: SupporterLeaderboardEntry
SupporterLeaderboardEntry.description: Publicly readable, PII-free FEVIQO Top Supporters leaderboard entry (verified customer contribution or admin-curated featured patron).

SupporterLeaderboardSettings.title: SupporterLeaderboardSettings
SupporterLeaderboardSettings.description: Admin-configurable display and ranking settings for the public FEVIQO Top Supporters leaderboard.
